name: inkwire
description: Local MCP server + shared drawing canvas for collaborating visually with an AI agent on a codebase.

scripts.dev: INKWIRE_PORT=4692 INKWIRE_DATA_DIR=$HOME/.inkwire-dev INKWIRE_IDLE_GRACE_MS=off INKWIRE_UI_WATCH=1 node --watch-path=plugin/src/server --watch-path=plugin/src/core --watch-path=plugin/src/shared --watch-path=plugin/src/link plugin/src/server/daemon.ts
scripts.health: vitest run tests/health tests/link tests/server/idle.test.ts tests/server/build-info.test.ts tests/server/ui-bundle.test.ts tests/server/fonts.test.ts tests/tools/clients.test.ts tests/tools/project-root.test.ts tests/tools/forward-hook.test.ts tests/tools/authorship.test.ts tests/integration/port-conflict.test.ts tests/integration/daemon.test.ts
scripts.plugin:validate: claude plugin validate . && claude plugin validate plugin
